payload.body: Carrier is a human-made signal-engineering construct: a high-frequency waveform selected and sustained to bear an information-bearing signal across a channel. Three parameters carve it: (1) frequency selection: a carrier frequency is chosen outside the information bandwidth and maintained stable by oscillators and control loops; (2) modulation coupling: information is impressed on the carrier via amplitude, frequency, or phase modulation, making the carrier the physical substrate that carries the message; (3) channel fit: the carrier’s spectral occupancy, power, and propagation characteristics are matched to the transmission medium and receiver. Carriers persist through engineering standards, hardware implementations, and operational practice: oscillators generate them, transmitters broadcast them, receivers lock to them, and protocols specify their use. [formal: carrier | substrate: matter | horizon: hours | explicit: yes | epoch: 0.02]
